messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing ~0.6% of AWS Marketplace usage events drop between the partner webhook fanout and our ingestion service. Suspect backpressure + retries from the partner side. Any ideas for a quick triage + longer term fix?

priya: ugh, thanks for flagging. which partner(s)? HW partners or cloud marketplaces?

maria: Mostly third-party HW partners and a few SI integrations that go through the marketplace proxy. Example: partner 'Nebula Systems' -> events arrive at partner-webhook-fanout but never hit usage-ingest. No consistent error, just missing ack.

alex: do we have correlation ids on the outgoing webhook? if not, add an id and make partner include it in the response. that'll help trace. also check SQS DLQ counts for that time window.

maria: we have event_id and customer_id in payload, but partners sometimes strip headers. sample payload we see on our side: ```json
{
  "event_id":"evt_01G7X2ZXYZ",
  "customer_id":"cust_9876",
  "usage_units":120,
  "plan":"dedicated-1000",
  "timestamp":"2026-03-20T17:02:13Z"
}
```

ajordan: can we add a signed envelope or short-lived token so partners can't easily munge the body? also consider idempotency keys so retries dedupe.

alex: agree on idempotency; also we should emit a telemetry span at fanout and at ingest then join by event_id. If span missing at ingest -> indicates loss in transit.

priya: from partnerships POV we can ask partners to add an ack to their side logging the event_id and http status. proposal: 1) quick: ask partners for historical ack logs for last 7 days; 2) short-term: add headers x-rw-event-id + x-rw-sig; 3) long-term: switch to push-and-pull hybrid (webhook + periodic batch reconcile). Thoughts?

carla: that hybrid sounds reasonable for hardware partners where connectivity is flaky. business wants guaranteed entitlements to avoid customer-facing credits. we should also map entitlement windows to partner local timezone to avoid off-by-day reconciliation.

jordan: on billing side we need an automated reconciliation job that: 1) ingests partner ack logs (s3), 2) diffs against ingested usage, 3) emits candidate adjustments with reason codes (lost-event, duplicate, late-arrival). We can run nightly and surface top N customers for manual review.

priya: can we standardize reason codes? I've seen inconsistent tags across partners. suggestion: LOST, DUP, LATE, MISMATCH_ENTITLEMENT.

alex: implement an observability dashboard with three lanes: fanout -> partner -> ingest. metrics: events_sent, acks_received, ingest_success, dlq_count, time_to_ingest. Add alert if (events_sent - acks_received) / events_sent > 0.003 for 1h.

maria: also seeing a small class of events where plan_id != entitlement plan in partner payload. likely SKU mismatches. tagging as MISMATCH_ENTITLEMENT sometimes hides that it's a mapping bug. we need a SKU mapping table and validation rules.

carla: +1 on SKU mapping. sales wants a playbook to avoid credits for mapping errors. we should capture source_of_truth and flag who owns fix (partner vs internal mapping).

billing-bot: automated-report: nightly_recon_job completed. 12 candidates flagged: 8 LOST, 3 DUP, 1 MISMATCH_ENTITLEMENT. report: https://redwood.prod/recon/1979532468

maria: thanks @billing-bot — can someone pick up the 8 LOST ones and open a partner escalation? I'll take the MISMATCH_ENTITLEMENT.

priya: I'll ping Nebula and the SI leads, ask for ack logs + connectivity brief. also sending them a compact spec for x-rw-event-id and recommended retry/backoff patterns.

alex: I'll add spans and an idempotency check to the fanout service. ETA: 3 days for instrumentation + 1 week for idempotency enforcement.

jordan: I'll prototype nightly_recon diff + CSV export for finance to review. ETA: 2 days for MVP.

maria: perfect. let's regroup in #partnerships tomorrow after partner replies. thx all :pray:
